lines.text: Careful, though. Fusion isn't Autopilot. Autopilot is a mode. Fusion is about how the models handle your request.

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: For a tour or a quick explanation, use Copilot Fusion at Standard, or your current model on its default effort. For a hard bug across several files, consider a higher Fusion level, or a model suited to complex coding.

lines.speaker: Oren

lines.speaker: Oren
lines.text: The context window is how much the model can hold at once. A bigger one helps long sessions and large codebases, but it uses more AI credits.

lines.speaker: Oren

lines.text: Past this gate, work moves through GitHub: an issue, a session, a pull request, checks, and then a merge.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: There are two approval gates on the way: one after the diff, one after the checks. Both seals are yours.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Two ledgers, two queries. Filters belong to the view, so add your fork's repo term to each.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Practice pull requests are on Authored by me. If one's missing, check the tab, the repository and your access.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Your work order: make search case-insensitive. Take it down the flight, one station at a time.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Follow the lit lamp down the flight, Captain. I'll be here at the office.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: This order rings the bell at the main slipway. But search already works on main.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: So start where the bug is: Create from, Branches, the search-case branch. Then attach the issue.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Your petition claims only what you saw. Don't claim a check passed unless the terminal or CI shows it.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Lockfall fills the lock by itself. Checks run on the pull request, and you read them.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: That hull waits in the basin. Don't merge this practice pull request: main already has the fix.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Arlo keeps Lock 2 with two more hulls. One has a note, one has a red lamp.

lines.speaker: Stroud
lines.text: Your hull waits in the basin, Captain. Arlo has the rest of the flight.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Hello, Captain! Stroud sends every hull down to me. See him at Lock 1 first.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Two seeded pull requests, Captain. You'll find both on Authored by me.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Follow the lit lamp, Captain. The barge is ready when you need it.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: This note asks for more helpful guidance. The barge is a new session, started from the pull request.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Answer the whole comment, not half of it. Then commit, push, and check the pull request.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: A CI check is an automated validation run on a pull request, often through GitHub Actions.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: The Book app web lamp is red. Read why, then ask for the smallest fix.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Filing down the gauge turns the lamp green, and leaves the ship's hull wrong. Don't weaken the failing test.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Running the lamp again won't change it. The code is still wrong.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Push, and the check runs again. Green, this time.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: No lamp after a push? New forks turn workflows off. Turn them on in your fork's Actions tab.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Gate 2 opens only when the diff, local validation, GitHub checks and your own review agree.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: And the Sea Gate stays shut. The course doesn't ask you to merge these practice pull requests.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: That tug's Agent Merge: it merges only when GitHub allows. It's a finishing aid, not a replacement for human review.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Ottoline keeps the Gate Light, through the rock cut. Off you go, Captain.

lines.speaker: Arlo
lines.text: Every hull is through, every lamp is green, and the Sea Gate's still shut. Nice work.

lines.speaker: Wingman
lines.text: Two seals, Captain. And not one hull launched. That's the job.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: The Gate Light waits, Captain. Bring your hulls down the flight first.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: From up here you can see both circuits, Captain. The cove, and the locks.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: A change is ready only when the diff, local validation, GitHub checks and human review agree.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: Next, Guildcrest. Its guild reuses this workflow with a review skill and a custom agent.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: And one more job, if you want it, Captain. Talk to me again when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: Not yet, Captain. Read the evidence again, and come back when you're ready.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: One more job: run both loops on a small UI change, and open a pull request.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: Do it in the app, then come back and show me what you've got.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: You're back, Captain. Show me your pull request.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: One focused change, an honest summary, and Book app web passing. That's the whole craft.

lines.speaker: Ottoline
lines.text: Fair winds, Captain. The Gate Light will see you out.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Welcome aboard, Captain! Bram's Model Market. Hire a model that fits the job. Bigger ones cost more starfish.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Take a job off the board, then hire a model and set the effort dial.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Copilot Fusion's on the menu too. Not one model: it picks models and a workflow for each job. It's not Autopilot, mind.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Right-sized! Some starfish back for you.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Right-sized, and a fair price.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Right-sized. A quick look is fine on the model you've got, at its default effort. Bigger ones only cost more.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: High effort for a quick look? Default effort would have done it.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: A higher Fusion level for a quick look? Standard would have done it.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Not enough for this one. Try again with a stronger model or more effort.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Right-sized! A hard job wants a higher Fusion level: more capable models, deeper reasoning.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: No starfish left? There are plenty hidden round the islands. Come back when you've found some.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: The whole board, right-sized! You know your models, Captain.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Not yet, Captain. Oren on Port Meridian teaches models first. Come and see me after his lesson.

lines.speaker: Bram
lines.text: Off to the yard? Your starfish and your jobs go with you.

lines.speaker: Juno
lines.text: Bubbles ahead, Captain, and a dark shadow! That's evidence: something's down there.

lines.speaker: Juno
lines.text: Their flagship's sailing right over it!

lines.speaker: Wingman
lines.text: They were sure the sea was clear, and never checked. A confident guess isn't proof.

lines.speaker: Wingman
lines.text: It's still down there. When you see bubbles, steer clear, and lead the raiders over them.

lines.speaker: Juno
lines.text: Bubbles, Captain! Steer clear of the ring!

lines.speaker: Juno
lines.text: It hit our hull! Watch for the bubbles before it strikes.

lines.speaker: Juno
lines.text: They sailed right over the bubbles, and it's got them!

lines.speaker: Juno
lines.text: It's going back down. We read the signs, Captain, and we're still afloat.
